name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">
    <description>
         Regular Gray-Scott Reaction-Diffusion, with reagents added for F, K, D_a and D_b.
The extra reagents each have a decay speed and a diffusion rate.

A mixable amount of these is used in the main formula, so that accumulation behaviour can be tuned before engaging its effect.

The difference (a - b) and the b reagent, can be used to 'emit' value into the extra reagents.

Emission amplitude is scaled by ctrlAmp and the decay rates are scaled by decayAmp.
    </description>
    <rule name="Gray-Scott" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.8
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.4
      </param>
      <param name="k">
        0.057
      </param>
      <param name="F">
        0.021
      </param>
      <param name="ctrlAmp">
        0.01
      </param>
      <param name="decayAmp">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="fDecay">
        7e-05
      </param>
      <param name="kDecay">
        0.002
      </param>
      <param name="daDecay">
        0.0005
      </param>
      <param name="dbDecay">
        0.001
      </param>
      <param name="fEffect">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="kEffect">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="daEffect">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="dbEffect">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="diffToF">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="diffToK">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="diffToDa">
        -0.14
      </param>
      <param name="diffToDb">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="bToF">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="bToK">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="bToDa">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="bToDb">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="D_F">
        0.01
      </param>
      <param name="D_k">
        0.01
      </param>
      <param name="D_Da">
        0.0017
      </param>
      <param name="D_Db">
        0.0001
      </param>
      <param name="powF">
        1.0001
      </param>
      <param name="powK">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="powDa">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="powDb">
        1.0001
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="6">
                c = pow( D_F * laplacian_c + (1.0f - fDecay * decayAmp) * c + fDecay * decayAmp * F, powF );
d = pow( D_k * laplacian_d + (1.0f - kDecay * decayAmp) * d + kDecay * decayAmp * k, powK );
e = pow( D_Da * laplacian_e + (1.0f - daDecay * decayAmp) * e + daDecay * decayAmp * D_a, powDa);
f = pow( D_Db * laplacian_f + (1.0f - dbDecay * decayAmp) * f + dbDecay * decayAmp * D_b, powDb);


delta_a = (daEffect * e + (1.0f-daEffect) * D_a) * laplacian_a - a*b*b + (fEffect*c + (1.0f-fEffect)*F)*(1.0f-a);
delta_b = (dbEffect * f + (1.0f-dbEffect) * D_b) * laplacian_b + a*b*b - ((fEffect*c + (1.0f-fEffect)*F)+(kEffect*d + (1.0f-kEffect)*k))*b;


delta_c = ctrlAmp * diffToF * ((1.0f - a) - b) + b * ctrlAmp * bToF;
delta_d = ctrlAmp * diffToK * ((1.0f - a) - b) + b * ctrlAmp * bToK ;
delta_e = ctrlAmp * diffToDa * ((1.0f - a) - b) + b * ctrlAmp * bToDa;
delta_f = ctrlAmp * diffToDb * ((1.0f - a) - b) + b * ctrlAmp * bToDb;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>

      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">

        <white_noise low="0" high="1">

          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <subtract>

        <rectangle>
